elements.scope_reason: Header is the box's trigger (unprotected sex in past 5 days AND does not want pregnancy). Everything under it is management, but the trigger is a patient-history criterion; 'Unprotected sexual intercourse' exists in SNOMED. House standard would arguably give a check task/priority for it.
parts_missing: any check task or priority evaluation for emergency contraception
elements.problem: No rule or check_for item references unprotected sexual intercourse; the red box has no encoding at all.

management_step / cross_reference_only (HIV and hep B PEP 119)

parts_missing: check task for STI symptoms (vaginal discharge, genital ulcer, lower abdominal pain)

elements.scope_reason: BP >=140/90 -> 148 and avoid COC; >=160/100 avoid injectable. Thresholds depend on whether the language has BP units; avoid/change is management.
elements.problem: Not encoded; at minimum a possible hypertension evaluation could be expected if BP is expressible.

elements.scope_reason: Lumps in breasts -> 55; lumps in axillae -> 42. Findings expressible, but they route to other pages.
Menopausal symptoms (hot flushes, night sweats, vaginal dryness, mood changes, difficulty sleeping) if >40 years -> 187.

elements.problem: Pregnancy 'suspected' with nausea / breast tenderness / missed period on COC is encoded as possible pregnancy and a check task. 'Before starting contraception' is not expressible as a finding and is correctly omitted. Minor: the task fires for every COC user and its criterion is the COC use itself, which is acceptable; nausea is non-specific but page lists it.
evidence: Check for suspected pregnancy on combined oral contraceptive :: (task ... (clinical_finding (snomed_concept "Uses combined oral contraception" "finding")) (check_for Nausea, Tenderness of breast, Missed period))
Diagnose possible pregnancy on combined oral contraceptive :: (and COC (or Nausea Tenderness-of-breast Missed-period))

elements.scope_reason: BMI >= 25 -> 156; BMI/weight numeric thresholds probably not_representable

rule_level_problems.problem: The red box (emergency contraception when unprotected sex in past 5 days and no wish for pregnancy) has no check task or priority evaluation; only the outside pregnancy-on-COC logic is encoded.

rule_level_problems.rule: Check for suspected pregnancy on combined oral contraceptive
rule_level_problems.problem: Task criterion is just COC use, so it triggers for all COC users; no check_for items for STI symptoms, breast/axillary lumps, menopause symptoms or BP, which the assessment table asks about every visit.

rule_level_problems.rule: Diagnose possible pregnancy on combined oral contraceptive
rule_level_problems.problem: Rule requires COC use; page also says check for pregnancy before starting contraception or if suspected generally, but that is not a finding. Acceptable; noted for completeness.

summary: The file encodes only one outside-the-box item (suspected pregnancy on combined oral contraceptive, as a possible diagnosis plus check task), which is correct with valid SNOMED concepts. The red box trigger (unprotected sex within 5 days, does not want pregnancy) is not encoded and the assessment table's checkable findings (STI symptoms, breast/axillary lumps, menopausal symptoms, BP thresholds) are missing; the remainder is management or cross-reference and out of scope.
